children: Humana reaffirmed FY 2026 guidance of at least $6.52 GAAP EPS and at least $9.00 adjusted EPS.
Senior management will meet investors during Sept 1–30 and will reaffirm FY 2026 guidance for EPS.
FY 2026 GAAP diluted EPS guidance: at least $6.52; adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS: at least $9.00.
Adjusted EPS adds items including intangibles, valuation adjustments, value creation, impairments, and tax impacts.
Will not comment on 2027 Medicare Advantage Star Ratings until CMS releases final 2027 ratings in October.

title: Humana reiterates FY 2026 GAAP EPS of at least $6.52 and Adjusted EPS of at least $9.00
